exposure: medical termination of pregnancy (using mifepristone and misoprostol) in the second trimester
cohort: The study included individuals who underwent a second-trimester medical termination of pregnancy between 2008 and 2023 and had a known subsequent pregnancy up to 2024.
finding: Second-trimester medical termination of pregnancy is generally considered safe regarding subsequent spontaneous preterm birth risk, although a significant positive association was found with higher gestational age at the time of termination when analyzed as a continuous variable.
